name: Any multirotor - auto-wired waypoint hold
notes: One controller for ANY multirotor: the script reads ctx.craft (rotor positions, spins, thrusts) and builds its own motor mixer, so the same experiment trains a quad, a hexacopter or a lopsided pentacopter. Swap the craft with pwcli --craft <file.json>. 9 gains, CMA-ES.
